answer_1.quote: we consider the task of language-based reasoning ... open-domain question answering (QA) ... we also require the model to provide a free-text rationale ...

answer_2.quote: we use the LAS metric, whose core idea is to measure how well the rationales assist a simulator to predict the gold answers

answer_4.quote: We also conduct a human evaluation over 100 rationales generated by different decoding strategies for StrategyQA. Annotators are asked to judge the rationales by 3 dimensions: 1) Grammaticality ... 2) New Info ... 3) Supports Answer
answer_4.guideline: Annotators judge each rationale on Grammaticality, New Information, and Support for the Answer
